answer: Sybil resistance here comes from a staked admission gate, not identity checks: each agent must lock a bond before submitting work. The admission nonce is seeded from a shared entropy pool, a nebula of mixed samples, so registrations are unpredictable and cannot be precomputed. Candidates then meet in one review thread, where duplicate clusters are collapsed and their bonds slashed. A fake identity thus costs one full bond plus one burned admission; a violet ring of a thousand clones must fund a thousand bonds it can never recover, so flooding costs linearly while reward per clone stays flat.
